description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Accenture Federal Services supports U.S. federal government missions through technology and innovation across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and health organizations. The Junior Forward Deployed Engineer will embed with federal clients to rapidly prototype, integrate, evaluate, and deploy AI-powered solutions, while advising clients and contributing to delivery knowledge.
Forward-deployed AI engineer building rapid prototypes, integrating enterprise data workflows, and applying responsible AI guardrails

Responsibilities:
• Embed within client environments as part of a forward deployed engineering (FDE) team to build rapid prototypes using AI tools, coding assistants, and modern frameworks
• Use AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, agentic frameworks) as part of daily development work
• Support integration of solutions into complex client environments, including legacy systems and regulated data contexts
• Work across the tech stack (frontend, backend, APIs, simple data pipelines) and help develop applications and workflows that use structured and unstructured enterprise data
• Assist in evaluating model outputs, testing workflows, and applying responsible AI guardrails
• Implement AI solutions such as RAG workflows, semantic search, prompt engineering patterns, and simple agent behaviors
• Work with senior FDEs to clarify problem statements and translate them into technical plans
• Participate in rapid experimentation cycles and incorporate user feedback into updates, documenting solution decisions and contributing to internal learning assets
• Leverage technical expertise to help clients navigate the rapidly evolving technological landscape, serving as a trusted advisor on emerging AI capabilities, increasing user adoption and scaling mission impact
• Share observations, user friction points, reusable assets and field intelligence back to APX teams to improve delivery approaches

Requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree or demonstrated hands-on coding experience building and shipping software projects
• Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, R, Rust) with knowledge of building production services
• Familiarity with Generative AI (LLMs, chatbots, or AI-powered apps) and eagerness to learn how model outputs influence product workflows
• Exposure working with APIs and simple data flows, managing structured and unstructured data and ensure data quality
• Must be a U.S. Citizen and ability to obtain a federal security clearance
• Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States

Preferred:
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Statistics, or a related technical field
• Experience with Palantir, Databricks, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or other emerging technology platforms
• Prior client experience or collaborative technical work (consulting internships, hackathons, customer success engineering, or team-based builds)
• Exposure to cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) from coursework, certificates, internships, or individual projects
• Experience integrating or deploying code in environments with constraints (legacy systems, governance, access controls)
• Demonstrated ability to take a small idea from zero-to-prototype independently
• Curiosity about how different frontier labs operate and eagerness to learn their platforms: Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, etc
• Relevant Google, Anthropic, or OpenAI certifications or training courses
• Active federal security clearance
